name: Opkit
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
long_description: Opkit uses AI to automate routine phone calls for medical practices, telehealth companies, and other leading healthcare provider organizations. Opkit's AI agent is capable of executing a wide-range of non-clinical phone call tasks, including Verification of Benefits, patient intake, and appointment scheduling, without human intervention. Opkit is HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type 2 certified.
one_liner: AI phone calls for the US healthcare industry

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Sherwood Callaway is a 2x YC founder and software engineer with over ten years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, and observability engineering roles top VC-backed startups, including Crunchbase and Brex. Currently, he is founder and CEO at Sazabi, the AI-native observability platform for fast-moving engineering teams. Sazabi is directly inspired by Sherwood's experience at Brex, where helped start the company's infrastructure and observability engineering teams.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Former early employee at Brex on Growth, Card, and Cash engineering teams. Before that, co-founder of SpeakGenius, an English learning tool. Studied entrepreneurship at the University of Southern California.
